newsitem.title: JAPAN: Victor rises on hopes of forecast revision.
newsitem.headline: Victor rises on hopes of forecast revision.

text.p: Victor Co of Japan Ltd shares jumped in the Tuesday morning session, as market participants speculated that the firm may revise its earnings forecast, brokers said.
They added that dealers were at the heart of today's trade, attracted to the issue by its high liquidity.
As of 0142 GMT, shares in the video cassette recorder manufacturer were up 40 yen at 1,420, a new high for calendar year 1997.
It was ranked seventh on the list of most heavily traded issues, with turnover of 1.18 million shares.
